source_provenance: Raw hashes identify actual Windows/image bytes. LF-normalized hashes identify committed Git blobs. All app/scripts Python files were verified inside both nested images. No own app/policy changes.

scope.daemon: SIGTERM/restart of real isolated child dockerd; same supervisor process and persistent Docker data root. Docker Desktop and unrelated workloads untouched.
scope.identity: Healthy pre-fault public Engine ID+anchor seal; pinned images/paired transition and owners. Explicit recovery; no election or identity re-learning after failure.
scope.completion: Restore only verified stopped worker IDs; no profile recopy, owner rewrite or epoch/key regeneration. Partial starts can be retried.
scope.live_restore: Actual running actor and both workers asserted after restart; production recovery refuses until explicit fixture-only operator fencing.
scope.security_marker: Synthetic public post-completion profile marker, not a new CA issuance/consumed JWT/revocation/PG campaign.
scope.previous_ca_campaign: PR20 real CA43/old-JWK132 proof is historical; not rerun or added to these totals.
scope.cost: Local Docker only; no AWS, paid LLM, real account or OS trust changes.
scope.fixture_api: Temporary loopback-only unauthenticated admin API inside an isolated privileged fixture. Not a production Docker endpoint recipe.

excluded_trials.reason: Setup could not address an imported image using the outer store ID. Fixture now pins the actual imported IDs and uses overlay2; no recovery checkpoint ran.

Ordinary restart/completion cases passed, but live-worker negative test incorrectly assumed workers survived the preceding live-restore configuration change. The legitimately quiescent cluster resumed. Excluded as an incomplete campaign.

Narrow diagnostic explicitly detected that workers had already stopped while enabling live-restore. Fixture now restores completed workers before asserting live actor/worker states. No production guard was weakened.

Earlier successful 15-check/12-restart campaign. Final code additionally refuses Running=true/Paused=true workers before starting any peer; the final fresh campaign adds that real paused-worker case. Not added to final totals.

limits: Same PC/kernel and trusted parent Docker/data root/surviving volumes/images. Not physical-host or data-root loss recovery.
Engine ID/checksums are not authentication or protection against malicious admin/full-state rollback.
Explicit recovery; no automatic kill of live-restored actors/workers, lease deletion or highest-epoch election.
General paired checkpoint disagreement and uncertain identity transfer remain investigation cases.
SIGTERM restart tests are not proof of arbitrary SIGKILL/power-failure durability.
No arbitrary busy reset, business POST retries, complete CA cold restore, production SLA/RTO/RPO or independent teammate review.
Separate persistent mTLS profile automatic CA renewal integration remains future scope.
Excluded trials and historical CA campaigns are not added to final counts.
